source: ExpressJS.pdf Section F; dependencies normalized to the 20 modules in Section B.

stages.title: Foundations
stages.focus: Understand the framework/runtime boundary, install Node.js, build the first server and learn HTTP.
stages.milestone: Developer Information Website starter and basic health route.

stages.title: Core Express
stages.focus: Routing, request/response objects, middleware ordering, parsing and validation.
stages.milestone: Task Manager API with validation and error paths.

stages.title: Complete API development
stages.focus: REST resource design, static/frontend integration, error handling, logging and database access.
stages.milestone: Inventory Management Backend with a local database.

stages.title: Security and integrations
stages.focus: Authentication, permissions, files, external APIs, webhooks and defense in depth.
stages.milestone: Authentication Service or Document Management API.

stages.title: Professional engineering
stages.focus: Tests, project boundaries, scalability, caching, deployment and incident readiness.
stages.milestone: Monitoring and Observability Service with automated tests.

stages.title: Compatibility and capstone
stages.focus: Express 4 maintenance, Express 5 migration and end-to-end release readiness.

prerequisite_map.requires: Basic routes, handlers and HTTP requests.
Request bodies, route parameters and query parameters.
Middleware, routes and safe response handling.
Async programming, database access and basic metrics.
Environment configuration, error handling and application startup.
Core modules through testing and deployment.

recommended_lesson_pattern: Small worked example with expected result
